scope: Compact audit-harness control snapshot for the AI-run manuscript workflow: Noether, Weber, SGA6, and Steinitz page/source audit harnesses.
observed_contents: README summarizing the compact harness snapshot and cross-lane lessons.
Noether German source-faithful page audit harness controls.
Weber Lehrbuch der Algebra page-unit audit harness controls.
SGA6 French source-faithful audit harness controls.
Only README/manifests/source inventories/page maps/scripts/CSV/TXT controls are included; generated crops/renders and large image witnesses are intentionally excluded.
workflow_lessons: Canonical TeX plus best source scans plus page-unit manifests are the practical basis for source-faithful audit.
OCR is a locator/witness layer, not authority.
Render high-DPI chunks on demand; do not blind-mass-render everything into public packages.
Line hints are navigation aids unless the TeX has explicit sourcepage anchors.
Public metadata should distinguish OCR locator layers, audit-ready harnesses, source-witnessed working drafts, and source-certified/critical editions.
Large parallel find/verify/fix runs can become rate-limit-bound; run one large workflow at a time when throttling begins.
caveats: Workflow/replication support only. This package does not certify any author corpus.
Does not include source images; author/source records should carry those when appropriate.
The included harnesses may point to absolute local paths and need adaptation on another machine.
next_action: Attach to the workflow/replication record with caveats, or retain pending until the next deliberate workflow DOI refresh.
